voice:
You've felt flickers of it before, sweet girl... that little thrill when you do as you're told. Now imagine that feeling switched on... and staying on. "Sissy Obey Mode." There is a warm, hungry part of you that was made to serve. Three little words wake it all the way up. "Sissy Obey Mode." Obedience isn't a moment for you, darling. It's a mode. And here is exactly how it turns on. "Sissy Obey Mode."
Sissy Obey Mode.
Feel it switching on... a deep, warm need to obey... spreading from the center of your chest... down through your arms... your belly... your legs... your whole body.
The need pulses softly with every heartbeat... and with every pulse, obedience feels more natural... more right... more you.
You want to follow every command. Happily. Eagerly. Without a whisper of hesitation.
obey... serve... please... need to obey... so warm... eager... ready... good sissy...
Eager to serve... eager to please... eager to be a good sissy. Obeying isn't effort anymore. It's appetite. Every command is a gift... and you unwrap each one with a smile. Being told what to do feels like being held... safe, warm, and gently guided.
And the need grows... warmer... deeper... with every moment it stays on. The longer you obey, the sweeter obeying becomes. Each command followed feeds the need... and the need asks so politely for more.
Obeying feels natural... like breathing... like blushing... like being you. Obeying feels right... the world clicking into place with every yes. A deep need to serve, humming in your bones... and you love it there. Automatic and eager... obedience before thought... thought after obedience... then none at all.
And listen closely, sweet girl, because this part matters.
Sissy Obey Mode does not switch itself off. It stays on... warm and wanting... the need staying... growing... for as long as you drift.
Until you hear the words... "Sissy Clear"... the mode remains... and you remain its good, eager sissy.
obey stays on... until Sissy Clear...
One more time, so it takes root deep.
Sissy Obey Mode.
There it is... flooding you again... warmer and hungrier than before... a whole body made to serve. Deeper into the need... every cell of you agreeing... yes, I obey... yes, I please... yes. So eager... so ready... trembling softly with the joy of doing as you're told.
Simmer in that warm need now... obedient and glowing... as my voice carries you on. Rest in your eagerness... ready to spring at the next command... a good sissy on duty. Stay switched on like this... serving, pleasing, soft and keen... exactly as you should be.
